disposition: gait speed in older adults with sarcopenia
assessment: The authors report no clear between-treatment difference in four-meter gait speed after the refined or extra-virgin oil regimens. The trial addresses sarcopenia outside Parkinson disease.

disposition: traditional use and isolated cell assays
assessment: The text mentions traditional use for insomnia and cites the Parkinson tea pilot. The experiment measured ion currents, calcium signaling and metabolic activity in cell preparations exposed to a dried-leaf extract.

disposition: constituent names in a marjoram experiment
assessment: Sagecoumarin and salvianolic acid are analytical identifications in marjoram extract. The experiments did not administer sage or measure behavioral pain or insomnia.

disposition: plant extracts in a laboratory screen
assessment: The table lists cinnamon bark, nigella seed and bay leaves in an acetylcholinesterase inhibition screen. The paper gives no fatigue ratings or Parkinson intervention.

disposition: formula added to laxative in chronic constipation
assessment: Twenty-two adults received Daikenchuto in addition to sennosides. The formula included processed ginger and Japanese pepper. Bowel frequency and laxative use showed no clear change. The Parkinson bowel report appears in the references.

disposition: abdominal pain in a combination formula study
assessment: Abdominal pain declined from baseline after adding the formula to sennosides. Processed ginger and Japanese pepper shared the intervention with ginseng and maltose. The preparation and population differ from the claim.

disposition: aroma massage and sleep questionnaire
assessment: The night-shift nurse trial used steam-extracted marjoram oil with almond carrier. The adjusted between-group change in total PSQI was inconclusive. The comparison used topical massage and aroma with no dietary marjoram arm.

disposition: clary sage in cited aromatherapy
assessment: The discussion cites a separate mixed clary-sage massage intervention. The current trial used marjoram and almond oils. Background fatigue and the sleep questionnaire supply no dietary sage comparison for pain, insomnia or fatigue.

disposition: almond carrier in a sleep massage trial
assessment: The active group received sweet almond oil with marjoram via massage. Oil grade was unreported and the study measured sleep in nurses without a depression scale.

disposition: oral multi-ingredient capsule and mouth pain
assessment: The uncontrolled dry-mouth study reported immediate improvement in oral pain and discomfort. The capsule contained Sichuan pepper and white sesame oils with menthol and lemon oil. Toasting and single-ingredient effects were untested.

disposition: olive oil and footprint gait after focal stroke
assessment: The olive-oil high-fat group did not improve reported footprint outcomes. The combination with DHA and EPA and the low-fat group improved some measures compared with saturated fat. The experiment used a focal stroke model and unspecified oil processing.

disposition: background caffeine exposure
assessment: The protocol recorded caffeine intake and required a caffeine-free interval before testing. The intervention randomized a Nepalese pepper extract or sunflower oil and did not administer brewed coffee.

disposition: ginger in formula background
assessment: The introduction describes ginger rhizome in Daikenchuto. The trial compared a Nepalese pepper lipid extract with sunflower oil in healthy adults. Neither arm administered ginger.

disposition: Nepalese pepper and mental task fatigue
assessment: The extract group reported lower task-induced mental fatigue on day 56 after a baseline fatigue imbalance. The species, oil extract, clinical population and rating differ from the frozen hypothesis.

disposition: traditional depression and toothache references
assessment: The traditional-use paragraph names depression and toothache. The trial used general mood, state anxiety and cognitive scales and supplied no clinical depression or pain comparison.

disposition: MCT in the active extract
assessment: The formulation identifies the MCT carrier without a coconut source or oil grade. Task fatigue and cognition outcomes in healthy adults compare the whole extract capsule with sunflower oil.

disposition: ungraded sunflower-oil comparator
assessment: Sunflower oil was the only comparator to pepper extract in MCT. The mood and state anxiety scales, fatigue battery and cognitive tasks provide no sunflower-oil effect relative to baseline diet or an oil-free control in Parkinson disease.

disposition: olive oil intake and sleep in observational obesity sample
assessment: The PREDIMED olive oil item was compared with PSQI. Participants reported no anxiety or depression. The study measured self-reported sleep quality without a separate anxiety outcome.

disposition: species-matched fruit essential oil in stressed mice
assessment: The fruit oil lowered forced-swim and tail-suspension immobility in the mouse experiments. The model and administered essential oil differ from dietary pepper and measured depressive symptoms in Parkinson disease.

disposition: traditional pain use outside measured endpoints
assessment: Pain relief appears as background. The primary experiments evaluated stress-associated behavior and laboratory markers after essential oil rather than a nociception or clinical pain outcome.
